title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — imputation and real inhaerentia fight; why do/suffer what another did loco me?
pass_a_gloss: Imputation and real inherence fight: what comes one way does not come the other. Why should I do or suffer what another did or suffered in my place?
pass_b_english: For what belongs by imputation does not belong by real inherence or inexistence. Those two fight each other. For why should I either do or suffer what another has done or suffered in my place?
source_text: Nam quod per imputationem convenit, non convenit per realem inhaerentiam sive inexistientiam. Duo istiusmodi inter se pugnant. Cur enim aut faciam aut patiar quod alius loco meo vel fecit vel passus est?
notes: Cap. IX inhaerentia densify section 648 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 355–356 tip).
